reviews.review_title: Review at Ding Doong Saigon Restaurant
reviews.review_text:
Jenny Thao Trang
1 contribution
0
Worthwhile experience service
Sep 2026 • Couples
We walked through District 1 with my friend and stopped to eat at a restaurant because I mainly wanted to introduce Vietnamese food to my friend. When entering the restaurant area, I didn't have high expectations because the space was quite enclosed, small, with continuous people coming and going, and most of the staff were quite young, and due to previous experiences, I didn't rate the service of young people these days highly.
Because I was very hungry, my friend ordered many dishes, and since the portion size was quite large, the staff had to put an extra empty table next to us, but the arrangement of the tables was quite close, which made me feel a bit uncomfortable because the two customers at the neighboring table kept looking over and seemed to be saying something about our table, and it was quite difficult for me to move in and out because there wasn't much space. I didn't want to make things difficult for the staff, so I didn't mention this issue.
Regarding the food, as a Vietnamese person, I find the dishes to be okay, the seasoning is easy to eat even if it's a bit sweet for me, but my friend rated the food here quite highly. Fresh juice, strong coffee.
The only thing that impressed me was the dedication, sincerity, and thoughtfulness of the staff, which I hadn't expected before. Since I ordered quite a few items, my friend asked you to pack them, and you were very enthusiastic and quick to put them in the box. I asked you to pack 2 to 3 times and then move the table so my friend and I could sit and have a drink afterward; you were very helpful and cheerful. Especially Huong/Phuong, I was impressed by your way of speaking and your care, friendly yet polite, not mechanical like in other restaurants I've experienced, your English is quite impressive, my friend felt the same way.
I'm not the type of person who writes reviews when using services anywhere, but this might be the first time I've experienced such comfort and care from the young staff, so I really took the time to write this for you, for Huong/Phuong, and for Dingdoong restaurant. 
Hope the restaurant achieves success in the future.

My overall experience has been superb , and can't say enough good things about not only the restaurant staff and cooks , but ALL the staff , from reception to door men , to cleaners ..... The management must be very proud of thier staff .
